description.narrative: Georgia - Regional Infrastructure Rehabilitation Project - Regional Infrastructure Development Activity: The objective of the Regional Infrastructure Development Activity is improved regional and municipal service delivery. The Activity will provide grants to fund regional and municipal physical infrastructure such as water supply, sanitation, irrigation, municipal gasification, roads and solid waste. MCC Funding will be used to make grants ("RID Grants") to regional governments, local governments, local self-government units, municipal utilities and the central government

sector.narrative: Water supply and sanitation - large systems
